message.content:
Based on my search, **The Walking Dead comic came first**.

The comic book series was **first published in October 2003** by Image Comics, created by writer Robert Kirkman and artist Tony Moore. The AMC television adaptation premiered **seven years later in October 2010**. The comic ran for 193 issues from 2003 to 2019, while the TV series aired from 2010 to 2022.
